# GearCompared — LLM-friendly site map

## About
GearCompared provides expert, hands-on reviews and comparisons of standing desks and kitchen appliances. We earn commissions from qualifying Amazon purchases at no extra cost to you.

## Site Structure
- Home: https://gearcompared.com/
- Standing Desks: https://gearcompared.com/standing-desks/
- Kitchen Appliances: https://gearcompared.com/kitchen-appliances/
- Disclosure: https://gearcompared.com/disclosure/
- Privacy: https://gearcompared.com/privacy/
- Terms: https://gearcompared.com/terms/
- Methodology: https://gearcompared.com/methodology/
- About: https://gearcompared.com/about/
- Contact: https://gearcompared.com/contact/

## Standing Desk Pages
